Decide on a desired income amount, like 1000 gold a turn, and don't buy units if the maintenance cost will take you below that.

Keep in mind the cost to maintain a unit is usually around a third of its cost per turn. That means if you have an army sitting back doing nothing, it is wasting alot of gold. If you need an army to garrison a province to keep it from rebelling, the cost is often more then the income from the province.

Do the bonus objectives. In addition to the main objectives there's also a bunch of secondary objectives that net you bonus gold. Try to do these before completing the main chapter objectives since the game advances as main chapter objectives are completed and you don't want to trigger the Chaos invasion too early.

If you click on your army engaged in a siege it should have a counter with the number of pieces of siege equipment built. I never really built that much siege equipment I usually just batter the gates down with monsters or blast the walls with artillery.
